'''MountainWest Gas Pipeline''' is an operating gas pipeline in Utah, Wyoming, and Colorado, United States.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mwpipe.com/Home/MWP#pagetitle|title=Home - MountainWest Pipeline (MWP)|website=www.mwpipe.com|access-date=2025-09-19}}</ref>
==Location==

The pipeline runs through northeastern Utah, southern Wyoming, and northwestern Colorado.<ref name=":1" />

*'''Capacity: '''2,600 MMcf/d<ref name=":2" />

==Background==

=== Westbound Compression Expansion Project ===
Proposed in 2023, the project includes the upgrading of compression stations and other infrastructure on the Overthrust Gas Pipeline in Wyoming. Target in-service date of Q4 2025. Construction began in February 2025.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.williams.com/expansion-project/mountainwest-overthrust-westbound-compression-expansion/|title=MountainWest Overthrust Westbound Compression Expansion {{!}} Williams Companies|work=Williams Companies|access-date=2025-09-19|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/7193|title=EIP Oil & Gas Watch|website=oilandgaswatch.org|language=en|access-date=2025-09-19}}</ref>
